taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: PyPI trusted publisher OIDC identity and release artifact selection
controls.source_trace: Follow accepted OIDC claims to project publication authority and ensure the uploaded distribution is from the approved immutable build.
controls.implementation_branch: Match the registered publisher repository, workflow and environment to the OIDC identity allowed to mint the upload token. A successful build is not evidence it selected the artifact eventually uploaded. Inspect reusable-workflow and artifact handoffs; a correctly rejected mismatch is a publisher-binding control, not proof that release contents are trustworthy.
controls.controlled_verification: Use a local policy fixture or owned test repository without public publication; compare intended workflow identity and a claim/artifact mismatch.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: An OIDC token request or PyPI project name in config is not a successful publishing grant.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Constrain publisher claims and artifact promotion, preserving intended release and rejecting mismatched contexts.
